| colspan="2" | First floor enemy gauntlet of the Coral Tower. Requires [[Elegy of the Deep]].

Most Coral Tower gauntlet enemies arrive from within coral pillars that shoot out from the floor or ceiling; the position of each is telegraphed by rumbling dust. These coral pillars can damage both Hornet and enemies that get hit.
